nodes.label: Two-pass, comment-safe extraction of `--{prefix}-name: value;` declarations.…
nodes.norm_label: two-pass, comment-safe extraction of `--{prefix}-name: value;` declarations....

nodes.label: Bordered box crumb with slash separator
nodes.norm_label: bordered box crumb with slash separator
nodes.rationale: Each crumb is a bordered box (border-action-3), never underlined text or chevrons; separator is a centered / character.

nodes.label: Button
nodes.rationale: ECO Design System button in variants, sizes and states; Breuer Condensed Bold uppercase.

nodes.label: Button hover white 20% overlay
nodes.rationale: Primary/Destructive/Accent hover layers surface-opacity-white-20 gradient over the solid background.

nodes.label: Button sizes lg/md/sm/xs desktop vs mobile
nodes.norm_label: button sizes lg/md/sm/xs desktop vs mobile
nodes.rationale: Desktop lg/md/sm/xs = 56/48/40/32px; mobile lg/md/sm/xs = 48/40/32/32px.

nodes.label: System button variant
nodes.rationale: Transparent with subtle border-action-3 (10% black) for system-level actions like filter/sort; System Selected adds opacity-black-12 fill.

nodes.label: Checkbox
nodes.rationale: Custom appearance:none input; always input+CSS, never img/SVG files.

nodes.label: Checkbox dark mode (.form-checkbox-item--dark)
nodes.rationale: Must be used on dark surfaces; never mix the light variant onto a dark background.

nodes.label: Checkbox 24x24 size model
nodes.rationale: 16px box plus 4px margin gives 24px area; focus outline 2px + 2px offset exactly fills the margin.

nodes.label: Checkbox table check-icon variant (.check-icon)
nodes.rationale: Table cells reuse the checkbox input, checked+disabled for permission granted.

nodes.label: Accent color tokens accent-default/light/dark
nodes.rationale: Brand-scoped: lime on Swedol.

nodes.label: ECO semantic color tokens
nodes.rationale: All tokens sourced as var(--color-*), values live in tokens.json.

nodes.label: Modal buttons always 32px tall
nodes.rationale: xs button on desktop, sm button on tablet/mobile; both 32px.

nodes.label: goToCompareView() switch-tab-then-scroll function
nodes.rationale: Reuses the table's setCompareView and scrolls with --header-top-h offset.

nodes.label: Role tier light vs dark card variants
nodes.norm_label: role tier light vs dark card variants
nodes.rationale: Base tier is light; extended tier .role-tier--dark uses surface-100 with accent-default title.

nodes.label: Role quicklinks (.role-quicklinks)
nodes.rationale: One System xs button per role in the intro as a quick table of contents.

nodes.label: Role Card / Tier Card pair
nodes.rationale: Two tiers side by side linking onward to a full comparison table.

nodes.label: Tile Link background colors White/Grey/Black
nodes.rationale: Spec table lists border tokens as background tokens; likely a token mix-up.

nodes.label: Tile Link Black hover white 20% overlay
nodes.norm_label: tile link black hover white 20% overlay

nodes.label: Tile Link
nodes.rationale: Graphical/prominent link as card or button; brand logos or icon+label.

nodes.label: Promotion uses brand-scoped accent tokens
nodes.rationale: Strong/Weak resolve via accent-default/accent-light so each concept brand (lime on Swedol, red on Tools) is correct without hardcoded hex.

nodes.label: Button keyboard-nav focus outline method
nodes.rationale: Uses outline with offset, not ::after inset, because inset measures from padding edge and bordered buttons lose the gap; shown only under body.keyboard-nav, never :focus-visible.

nodes.label: Checkbox Disabled Selected gray box with gray checkmark
nodes.norm_label: checkbox disabled selected gray box with gray checkmark
nodes.rationale: Must not look like the hover-selected style (dark fill + white checkmark).

nodes.label: Checkbox light-mode focus ring deviates from border-focus
nodes.norm_label: checkbox light-mode focus ring deviates from border-focus
nodes.rationale: Spec hardcodes blue #0052CC unlike every other form component (var(--color-border-focus)); flagged to confirm with design.

nodes.label: Never hardcode hex, use var(--color-*)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth in tokens.json keeps brands consistent.

nodes.label: Feature strips must be grounded in comparison table rows
nodes.norm_label: feature strips must be grounded in comparison table rows
nodes.rationale: Card content must match what the table actually shows.

nodes.label: Scroll to anchored sections with --header-top-h offset
nodes.norm_label: scroll to anchored sections with --header-top-h offset
nodes.rationale: Plain scrollIntoView hides section top behind sticky header.

nodes.label: Segment Control has no own focus style
nodes.norm_label: segment control has no own focus style
nodes.rationale: Buttons inherit the global keyboard-nav outline; a separate ring would duplicate focus indication.

nodes.label: Tile Link border is absolute ::before inset 0
nodes.norm_label: tile link border is absolute ::before inset 0
nodes.rationale: Border doesn't affect layout dimensions.

nodes.label: Action Link
nodes.rationale: Standalone clickable link with optional left/right icon; underline appears only on hover; used for navigation and downloads.

nodes.label: Action Link Text Primary Inverted variant
nodes.norm_label: action link text primary inverted variant
nodes.rationale: For dark backgrounds; uses text-action-primary-inverted tokens.

nodes.label: Breadcrumb Active (last, current page) state
nodes.rationale: Bold, black, aria-current=page, not clickable, no hover underline.

nodes.label: Breadcrumb
nodes.rationale: Shows position in page hierarchy; placed directly under header as first element in .page.

nodes.label: Collapsible / Accordion
nodes.rationale: Row-based expandable component (FAQ) with header, chevron and animated content.

nodes.label: Collapsible max-height animation via toggleCollapsible()
nodes.rationale: CSS cannot transition to auto, so JS sets max-height to scrollHeight.

nodes.label: Inline Link
nodes.rationale: Used inside sentences; underlined when enabled, underline removed on hover, never with icons.

nodes.label: Easing tokens decelerate/accelerate/standard
nodes.rationale: decelerate-emphasized for entrances, accelerate-generic for exits, standard for hover.

nodes.label: Pagination (load more)
nodes.rationale: Load-more pattern with counter, progress bar and Secondary md button; 190px wide and centered.

nodes.label: My Pages page-title section spacing
nodes.rationale: main-content padding-top 24/40; page-preamble margin-bottom 24/32/40.

nodes.label: Section padding per breakpoint first vs other
nodes.norm_label: section padding per breakpoint first vs other
nodes.rationale: First section has lower top padding; other sections 32/48/56/72 top, 40/48/64/80 bottom.

nodes.label: Page Divider
nodes.rationale: Thin horizontal line between two sections of the same background.

nodes.label: Section
nodes.rationale: Modular full-width block with breakpoint-adaptive padding and surface raised primary/secondary.

nodes.label: Section zeroed-padding use cases
nodes.rationale: Five defined cases: divider, adjacent topic, fluid hero, first section next to spaced component, first section with fluid banner.

nodes.label: Spacing consumer classes mt-space, pt-space, gap-space
nodes.norm_label: spacing consumer classes mt-space, pt-space, gap-space

nodes.label: Layout Vertical Whitespace space-sm/md/lg
nodes.rationale: Breakpoint-adaptive T-shirt scale for air between a section's content blocks (space-lg 32-56px, space-md 24-48px).

nodes.label: Spacing
nodes.rationale: Spacing tokens apply to all margins, padding, gaps; mostly multiples of 8px.

nodes.label: Action Link icons never underlined on hover
nodes.norm_label: action link icons never underlined on hover
nodes.rationale: Icon inherits text-decoration from hovered link, so .action-link .ms must set text-decoration:none explicitly.

nodes.label: Breadcrumb built-in spacing zeroes following section top padding
nodes.norm_label: breadcrumb built-in spacing zeroes following section top padding
nodes.rationale: Component has its own vertical padding, so .breadcrumb + .main-content/.section gets padding-top:0 to avoid stacking.

nodes.label: Breadcrumb uses --px-page not --px-full
nodes.rationale: Breadcrumb sits inside width-constrained .page so the grid margin token is correct.

nodes.label: Hide last row bottom line when list closes a section
nodes.norm_label: hide last row bottom line when list closes a section
nodes.rationale: Avoids a purposeless line above the section's own bottom padding; conditioned on the list's parent being the section's last child.

nodes.label: Collapsible header uses min-height not height
nodes.norm_label: collapsible header uses min-height not height
nodes.rationale: Header must grow if the title wraps.

nodes.label: Inline Link vs Action Link difference
nodes.norm_label: inline link vs action link difference
nodes.rationale: Opposite underline behavior, inline vs inline-flex display, icons never vs optional.

nodes.label: Hide the whole pagination once all items loaded
nodes.norm_label: hide the whole pagination once all items loaded
nodes.rationale: Hiding only the button leaves a misleading counter and progress bar.

nodes.label: Pagination has no bottom padding of its own
nodes.norm_label: pagination has no bottom padding of its own
nodes.rationale: Section's own bottom padding already gives air; adding more would double spacing.

nodes.label: Use --px-full not --px-page for divider/section
nodes.rationale: --px-page lacks xl centering against max-w; --px-full keeps divider aligned with section content.

nodes.label: Inline Link (in body text, always underlined)
nodes.norm_label: inline link (in body text, always underlined)

nodes.label: Dev, preview, staging, production deployment workflow (Vercel)
nodes.norm_label: dev, preview, staging, production deployment workflow (vercel)

nodes.label: Rule: do not change data table structure in frontend
nodes.norm_label: rule: do not change data table structure in frontend

nodes.label: E-Com Toast: Add to cart variant
nodes.norm_label: e-com toast: add to cart variant

nodes.label: System Toast statuses and Strong/Weak emphasis
nodes.norm_label: system toast statuses and strong/weak emphasis

nodes.label: Typography scale (Body, Alt-Label, Label, Title, Headline, Display)
nodes.norm_label: typography scale (body, alt-label, label, title, headline, display)

nodes.label: Notification status colors and reserved status icons
nodes.norm_label: notification status colors and reserved status icons

nodes.label: Prototype workflow (understand, template, components, compose, critique)
nodes.norm_label: prototype workflow (understand, template, components, compose, critique)

nodes.label: prototype-guide skill (entry point for creative work)
nodes.norm_label: prototype-guide skill (entry point for creative work)

nodes.label: Rule: reference var(--token), never hardcode hex/px
nodes.norm_label: rule: reference var(--token), never hardcode hex/px

nodes.label: Guardrails: ECO wins over general design advice
nodes.norm_label: guardrails: eco wins over general design advice

nodes.label: CTA banner (Ta steget – skapa företagskonto nu!)
nodes.norm_label: cta banner (ta steget – skapa foretagskonto nu!)

nodes.label: Badge/Basic (.badge-basic)
nodes.rationale: Non-interactive status/label indicator; class named .badge-basic to avoid clashing with the header cart counter .badge.

nodes.label: Badge emphasis Strong/Weak/Weaker
nodes.rationale: Formula per state: surface-{state}-default/weak/weaker with matching border and text tokens.

nodes.label: Badge letter case parameter
nodes.rationale: Sentence Case (500) is default; Upper Case (700 + uppercase) is a deliberate style switch for fixed category labels.

nodes.label: Badge states Neutral Grey/Dark and Alert Info/Success/Warning/Danger
nodes.norm_label: badge states neutral grey/dark and alert info/success/warning/danger

nodes.label: Banner Notification
nodes.rationale: Page-wide notification at top of page that persists until closed; not for action feedback (Toast/Inline) or blocking confirmation (Modal).

nodes.label: Banner emphasis Strong/Weak/Weaker
nodes.rationale: Three-tier ladder per status (information/success/warning/danger) shared by Small and Large.

nodes.label: Banner Promotion variant
nodes.rationale: Replaces old E-Com Action; Dark/Light/Strong/Weak; Small size only, centered, no status icon or left border.

nodes.label: Banner size Small/Large
nodes.rationale: Small is general purpose; Large is a rich icon+heading+body+buttons banner exclusive to My Pages.

nodes.label: Elevation and shadows
nodes.rationale: Bigger and softer shadow means higher elevation; use sparingly.

nodes.label: Shadow Bottom elevation-b-20 to b-100
nodes.rationale: Most common; b-20 cards/tables, b-40 tooltip, b-60 notification, b-80 header/menu, b-100 modals.

nodes.label: Shadow Top elevation-t-*
nodes.rationale: Used sparingly; never mixed with Bottom on one component.

nodes.label: Inline Notification Actionable layout
nodes.rationale: Adds buttons/text link below text indented 32px.

nodes.label: Informational E-Com inline variant
nodes.rationale: Always white background and only a 2px left blue border; icon chosen contextually.

nodes.label: Inline Notification emphasis System Strong/Weak
nodes.rationale: Only Strong/Weak; Weaker is a Banner-only concept.

nodes.label: System Inline Notification
nodes.rationale: Stays in page context until user acts; not short-lived like Toast, not blocking like Modal.

nodes.label: Inline Notification sizes Large/Small
nodes.rationale: Large 48px/24px icon, Small 32px/20px icon.

nodes.label: Modal fills viewport on xs mobile
nodes.norm_label: modal fills viewport on xs mobile
nodes.rationale: Not centered; fixed full viewport with buttons pinned to bottom.

nodes.label: E-Com Modal
nodes.rationale: Requires confirmation or active choice before user continues; ESC exit and backdrop click close.

nodes.label: Modal sizes Small/Medium/Large
nodes.rationale: 440/600/705px desktop, 576px tablet for Medium/Large, full viewport on mobile.

nodes.label: Badge color-meaning mapping for lifecycle status
nodes.norm_label: badge color-meaning mapping for lifecycle status
nodes.rationale: Keep color to meaning consistent within a project (New=Success weak, Updated=Info weak, In progress=Warning weak, Archive=Neutral Grey weaker).

nodes.label: Badge vs Tag vs counter bubble distinction
nodes.norm_label: badge vs tag vs counter bubble distinction
nodes.rationale: Badge is never interactive; Tag is interactive filtering; .badge is the circular cart counter.

nodes.label: Large banner exclusive to My Pages
nodes.norm_label: large banner exclusive to my pages
nodes.rationale: Heavier content contract (icon, title, body, CTA group) only fits signed-in dashboard contexts.

nodes.label: Strong emphasis replaces System Extra Strong
nodes.norm_label: strong emphasis replaces system extra strong
nodes.rationale: 2026-09 Figma restructure merged the centered admin-impersonation variant into left-aligned Strong.

nodes.label: Always choose lowest possible elevation level
nodes.norm_label: always choose lowest possible elevation level
nodes.rationale: Excessive elevation distracts; b-20 is default for card-like surfaces, modals at b-100.

nodes.label: Medium renamed to Large in 2026-09 update
nodes.norm_label: medium renamed to large in 2026-09 update
nodes.rationale: Same dimensions, name only; old inline-notification--medium classes must be renamed.

nodes.label: Modal is content-led with no status variant
nodes.norm_label: modal is content-led with no status variant
nodes.rationale: Unlike Banner/Inline/Toast it has a single neutral treatment with Confirm/Cancel hierarchy.

nodes.label: tokens/_test.html (unused placeholder)
nodes.rationale: Contains only the comment 'unused, safe to delete'.

nodes.label: Filter and sort drawer (Filtrera och sortera; produkter/företaget)
nodes.norm_label: filter and sort drawer (filtrera och sortera; produkter/foretaget)

nodes.label: ECO Design System tokens (alligo-design-tokens CSS + styles.css)
nodes.norm_label: eco design system tokens (alligo-design-tokens css + styles.css)

nodes.label: Checkbox light and dark mode showcase
nodes.norm_label: checkbox light and dark mode showcase

nodes.label: Spacing scale, shadow/elevation, border width and radius tokens
nodes.norm_label: spacing scale, shadow/elevation, border width and radius tokens

nodes.label: Users page (Användare)
nodes.rationale: Main user-administration page under My Pages; largest prototype page.

nodes.label: Users dashboard page (Användare with stat cards)
nodes.norm_label: users dashboard page (anvandare with stat cards)

nodes.label: Contact info section (Hur man kontaktar oss)
nodes.norm_label: contact info section (hur man kontaktar oss)

nodes.label: Add user drawer (Lägg till ny användare)
nodes.norm_label: add user drawer (lagg till ny anvandare)

nodes.label: Stat card (label, value, sub, progress bar)
nodes.norm_label: stat card (label, value, sub, progress bar)

nodes.label: Users data table with column order and visibility
nodes.norm_label: users data table with column order and visibility

nodes.label: Feedback: Do not change table structure
nodes.norm_label: feedback: do not change table structure
nodes.rationale: User explicitly instructed that table structure, column definitions, ordering logic and layout stay untouched unless the request directly targets the table.

nodes.label: Rule: never alter data-table structure (COLS order, column visibility JS)
nodes.norm_label: rule: never alter data-table structure (cols order, column visibility js)
nodes.rationale: Adjacent work (tooltips, drawers, styling) must leave table HTML, COLS array order, applyColOrderToTable, buildColList and column visibility logic exactly as they are.

nodes.label: Component-specific elevation tokens
nodes.rationale: Switch and table-overflow shadows are never used outside their component.

nodes.label: Duration tokens fast/medium/slow
nodes.rationale: Fast 50-200ms, Medium 250-400ms, Slow 450-600ms with four steps each.

nodes.label: Motion easing and duration
nodes.rationale: Animation conveys intent; timing, spacing and ease as three basic concepts.

nodes.label: Pagination progress bar
nodes.rationale: 2px bar with width computed via JS as visible/total.

nodes.label: Segment Control fluid width only at xs
nodes.norm_label: segment control fluid width only at xs
nodes.rationale: width 100% below 640px; content-based width from sm while keeping mobile height.

nodes.label: Segment Control
nodes.rationale: Pill toggle for switching between two related views/filters.

nodes.label: Segment Control sliding pill thumb
nodes.rationale: Separate thumb element positioned by JS via offsetLeft/offsetWidth, transition medium-2 standard.

nodes.label: Distance drives duration group
nodes.rationale: Short <=25% of view uses fast; medium 26-50% medium; long 51-100% slow.

nodes.label: Segment Control never replaces Tabs or Radio buttons
nodes.norm_label: segment control never replaces tabs or radio buttons
nodes.rationale: Tabs navigate content; radios are submitted form choices.

nodes.label: Designated Level elevation-drawer-*
nodes.rationale: Global drawers and navigation always use drawer shadows, never elevation-b-*.

nodes.label: Drawer conventions
nodes.rationale: Overlay opacity-black-20, width min(500px,100%), header scroll shadow b-60 toggled by JS.

nodes.label: Drawer mobile base styling at max-width 768px
nodes.norm_label: drawer mobile base styling at max-width 768px
nodes.rationale: Every component in the drawer switches to Mobile Base Styling (smaller title, 40px inputs, stacked form-row).

nodes.label: Input Field
nodes.rationale: Text input with sizes Large/Small/XSmall, seven states, label/hint anatomy; border-radius 0.

nodes.label: Label above input, hint/message below pattern
nodes.norm_label: label above input, hint/message below pattern
nodes.rationale: Label uppercase Bold; message is body-sm with 4px gap.

nodes.label: Input sizes per breakpoint
nodes.rationale: Desktop Large 48px, Small 40px, XSmall 32px; Mobile Large 40px, Small 32px.

nodes.label: Input states enabled/hover/active/focus/error/success/disabled
nodes.rationale: Every state must be implemented each time.

nodes.label: Select
nodes.rationale: Dropdown using appearance:none with custom 24px arrow; sizes and states follow Input.

nodes.label: Select states
nodes.rationale: Seven states identical to Input.

nodes.label: Input focus ring is absolute inset -3px, keyboard-only
nodes.norm_label: input focus ring is absolute inset -3px, keyboard-only
nodes.rationale: Ring is an ::after element on the wrapper, shown only under body.keyboard-nav, animated with opacity.

nodes.label: Select active state requires JS .is-active
nodes.rationale: Cannot use :not(:placeholder-shown) on select, so JS toggles the class when a non-default option is chosen.
